blurb: An `Asset` names a file the platform serves; it is not data to keep or send. So an `Asset` cannot be a record field, a sum payload, an event field, an agent key or store field, or part of a service or agent handler signature. What crosses is its `.url`, a `String`: hold that instead. Other types refused there include `bynk.types.function_at_boundary` and `bynk.types.held_at_boundary`.
summary: An `Asset` type appears in a record field, boundary or store position; pass its `.url` instead.
